module1.coverage_effect: S1 produced more 0-to-positive discoveries, higher final oracle coverage, lower final pairwise correctness correlation, and higher effective ensemble size than S0 in all 3 seeds.
module1.main_failure_mode: S1 converted a smaller fraction of created orphans than S0 in seeds 48 and 49, created more persistent singleton coverage in all 3 seeds, and expanded the final oracle-vote gap in all 3 seeds.

module2.main_failure_mode: S2 late plateaus were usually dominated by common-safe constraint conflicts after valid candidates existed; generation/critic scarcity remained material, especially in seed 50.

evidence: S1 increased final oracle coverage versus S0 by +3, +10, and +2 examples in seeds 48, 49, and 50.
S1 increased final vote count by only +2, 0, and +1, so the final oracle-vote gap increased by +1, +10, and +1.
S1 persistent-singleton rates exceeded S0 in all 3 seeds: 0.412 vs 0.286, 0.455 vs 0.000, and 0.167 vs 0.000.
S1 orphan vote-conversion rates were lower than S0 in seeds 48 and 49 and higher only in seed 50.

The proposed unique-ownership-to-no-reinforcement chain is contradicted by observed branch assignment: 48/51 S1 and 42/48 S2 orphan episodes were revisited by another member before conversion or coverage loss.
Only 24/48 S2 orphan episodes had a later different-member explicit conditioned-context hit, leaving an execution-level propagation gap.
S2 improved reinforcement, conversion, persistence, latency, and vote yield relative to S1 in seeds 48 and 49, but reversed several of those directions in seed 50.

primary_plateau_cause.limitations: Candidate-level rejection reasons cannot be uniquely attributed to individual residuals, and rejected-candidate per-example repair-distance deltas are not persisted.

research_questions.RQ3: Per-seed S1 orphan fates are reported exactly in orphan_creation_events.csv; pooled across seeds: 31 vote-converted, 19 singleton-until-end, 1 coverage-lost-again, and 0 reinforced-but-still-wrong.
research_questions.RQ5: S1: generation/critic scarcity. S2: common-safe conflict plus seed-specific generation/critic scarcity; explicit conditioned-context propagation is incomplete.
research_questions.RQ6: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_FOR_A_NEW_METHOD; evidence supports studying stronger explicit propagation, but does not support the premise that unique ownership currently prevents cross-member revisit.

recommended_next_action: Treat this as a design implication only: use fixed-trajectory offline replay to isolate explicit context propagation and common-safe candidate quality before defining or implementing a new method. Do not tune from these three development seeds alone.
